newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts eye downside, target 111-30.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts eye downside, target 111-30.

text.p: September gilts face further losses on Friday, particularly if they break through initial support at 113-00 which would open the way for a move to 111-30, technical analysts said.

"It looks like gilts will remain under pressure today," said Chase technical analyst Guenter Redeker. "There's trendline support at 113-00, and we need to get a break below there to allow further downside pressure to test 111-30."
Redeker said a break below that level would open up potential for a move to Elliott support at 111-17.
By 0712 GMT, gilts were up 2/32 at 113-05.
Redeker said the whole decline from the May 9 high at 114-31 was corrective, and added once the market reached 111-17, it would continue its medium term upmove.
Juliette Clark, from the Futures Trading Group at the Royal Bank of Scotland, agreed congestion support at 113-00/04 was the downside decision level on Friday.
She said the long term profile was still bullish and added there was plenty of scope for a Friday afternoon short squeeze.
"A steady climb this morning to 113-12/13 will establish a trading range, with support remaining at 113-00/04," she said in a note for clients.
Clarke said the upside view would improve once 113-12/13 was hurdled, leaving the next target at 113-17.
"If 113-17 is also overcome then the rally will gather speed and a full retracement of yesterday's losses should follow," she said.
Redeker put initial resistance at 113-12, an intra-day level established on Thursday, then 113-26, Thursday's high.
By 0722 GMT, September short sterling was down one basis point at 93.03 and the December contract was also down 0.01 at 92.83.
